intent: A dark invoice table where sorting is physical: rows travel to their new places and a spotlight glides to the sorted column. Resizable columns, sweep-select checkboxes with a counting selection total, a sticky header, density switch and an ARIA grid with roving focus. Folds into cards under 520px.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@container, container variants, CSS variables)
stack.animation: motion/react (layout="position" on rows, motion values, variants with custom delays, useInView, AnimatePresence, layoutId)

layout.root: @container, max-width 1040px, radius 16px; head (title + count + description, density switch right), then the scroller
layout.grid: role=grid of CSS grid rows sharing --dt-cols: 48px checkbox column, each column at its width, the last minmax(width, 1fr)
layout.fit: unresized columns shrink proportionally towards minWidth to fit the measured container; then the table scrolls sideways in its own scroller
layout.rows: header 40px; rows 52px regular, 36px compact; cells padded 12px; hairline ink/7% under each row
layout.stickyHeader: on: rows scroll inside maxHeight (440px) under a pinned header that gains a soft shadow once scrolled; off: the table grows to fit
layout.selectionBar: floating, centred, 12px from the bottom, 48px tall, radius 13px; body gains 68px bottom padding while it shows
layout.narrow: under 520px rows become cards: checkbox, title, value on one line; other columns as an indented 12.5px meta line; header replaced by a Sort button row

typography.title: Geist 17px semibold, tracking -0.02em; row count mono 11px ink/38
typography.headerLabels: mono 11px uppercase, tracking 0.08em, ink/45; sorted column full ink
typography.entity: 14px medium with a 24px monogram tile (mono 9.5px initials)
typography.date: 13.5px tabular ink/75, Intl short month + day
typography.currency: 14px medium, tabular-nums, right-aligned; fraction at ink/38

color.dark: stage #000000, card #0b0b0c with inset white/8% hairline and white/5% top highlight, ink #f4f4f5, bar #1c1c1f
color.light: stage #f4f4f5, card #ffffff, ink #111113, bar #111113 with #fafafa ink
color.accent: #5e9eff via the accent prop: checked boxes, selected rows (11%, 15% hover), resize guide and width chip, the selection total
color.status: semantic dots with 3px 16% halos: positive #4ade80, warning #fbbf24, negative #f87171, neutral #71717a (light: #16a34a, #d97706, #dc2626, #a1a1aa)
color.spotlight: sorted column ink/3.5% with ink/5% side hairlines

motion.sort: rows layout=position on spring 340/36 (mass 0.9): every row travels to its new slot together; ties keep original order
motion.spotlight: x and width motion values, spring 500/40, glide to the sorted column
motion.arrow: rotates 180deg on spring 500/40 between directions; hidden until hover (40%), solid when sorted
motion.resize: template written to the grid element during the drag (no render per move), committed on release; handle line grows 14→24px on hover and goes accent full-height with a guide and width chip while dragging
motion.bar: rises 14px from a 4px blur in 320ms; leaves 10px in 200ms ease-in; total counts to its new value in 600ms
motion.density: row height transitions 150ms; switch thumb is a layoutId on spring 500/40
motion.entrance: once at 20% in view: card 0s (16px rise from 8px blur, 600ms), head 0.08s, labels 0.14s, rows from 0.2s 35ms apart (capped after 12), amounts count from zero 100ms after their row, spotlight fades in at 0.55s
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms opacity fades only; no row travel; figures set instantly; spotlight jumps

responsive.container: columns fit the container down to their minimums, then scroll sideways inside the table; never the page
responsive.narrow: cards under 520px with a Sort row; selection bar hides the total label under 520px and the actions under 420px
responsive.touch: checkbox hit areas 44px; sweep-select uses pointer capture and touch-action none on the boxes only

accessibility: role=grid with aria-rowcount, aria-colcount and aria-multiselectable; rows aria-selected and aria-rowindex
sortable columnheaders carry aria-sort; header labels are buttons
roving tabindex: one tabbable cell; arrows, Home/End, Ctrl/Cmd+Home/End, PageUp/PageDown
Space toggles the row, Shift+Up/Down extends, Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all, Escape clears
Shift+Left/Right on a header resizes by 16px; separators expose aria-valuenow/min/max
polite live region for sort, selection and resize
density switch is a radiogroup with arrow keys; icon button labelled 'Clear selection'
keyboard-only 2px focus rings inset on cells

content.title: Invoices
content.data: 40 seeded invoices INV-2084 down to INV-2045, the demo shows 14

avoid: zebra stripes, vertical gridlines or a coloured header band
rows that snap to their new order instead of travelling
React state updated on every pointer move while resizing
horizontal page scroll at any width
colour anywhere but selection and semantic status dots
dataRobustness: An empty columns array shows the themed title and emptyLabel status. Metadata and numbers use at least 65% ink so both themes remain legible.
